reviewer: Sol (offline normalizer author, independent of Sol2 runtime/UI/client/index implementation)
scope: Read-only independent review of optional House reference publication descriptors, runtime catalog byte authentication and exact forecast matching, client error/abort paths, index generation, open-view refresh and UI wording.
Used completed all16 synthetic V1 and V2 normalizer -> native view -> forecast -> runtime matcher integration as compatibility evidence. No new tests or expensive test repetition.

checks.finding: Client selects current registry/API default when runId is null, follows stable model IDs on background refresh, and binds references only to chamber+runId+exact public result SHA. Reused IDs with new bytes cannot inherit old errors. Reference catalog actual bytes must match served publication SHA; matcher verifies exact copied native SHA, joint bank, dates/configuration, ordered winner/pair cohorts and source pins.

Missing House publication is an ordinary absent reference. Malformed optional House descriptor is isolated from valid Senate full/primary references. Failed House catalog/hash/match/timeout returns no House reference with a visible retry error and preserves authenticated House forecast; there is no borrowed Senate or old-edition numeric reference. See residual required-index asymmetry.

UI explicitly distinguishes 435 winner/group top-choice misses from 412 named-pair margin/interval metrics and 23 unavailable pair contests. Every supported pair counts equally. Self-reference and precision notes disclaim observed error/grade, empirical accuracy, separately qualified transformed-metric thresholds, and endpoint precision.

House projection and sidecar matcher both select exact tied modal outcomes in declared D,R,O party order; member/group identity is preserved and pooled probabilities are not assigned to individual candidates. Senate retains its separate outcome-ID rule. Modal miss expectation is independently checked against native probabilities.

House reference runtime and index validate timestamps/order plus exact forecast/descriptor configuration; there is no hardcoded House issue-date allowlist. Later dated editions of the supported native current16 menu use data-driven pins. Index retains older run+SHA editions without falsely matching new bytes. New scientific target laws or new menu/schema semantics remain intentionally unsupported until separately implemented/reviewed. Qualified Senate runtime descriptor path supplies dates/configuration/policy pins; legacy constants remain fallback only.

UI prevents overlapping refreshes in one effect, aborts/marks disposed on request/unmount changes, and checks abort/disposal before committing state. Client uses eight-second index/reference deadlines and checks parent/reference abort after non-abortable hash work. Forecast plus references are replaced together; old forecast remains explicitly labeled during a background load failure.

All16 synthetic configurations with differing truthful per-result issue times attach losslessly through actual forecast projection/matcher for both original NPZ V1 and segmented-index V2 metadata. PMF integer-row/quantile/mean/population-SD checks agree, as do435/412/23/tie and exact edition pins.

residualLimitations.detail: parseElectionNightPublicationIndex requires valid full and primary Senate descriptor blocks. A malformed required Senate descriptor invalidates the complete index, making a valid optional House reference unavailable while preserving the House forecast. Isolation is asymmetric: malformed House is isolated from Senate, but malformed required Senate descriptor is not isolated from House reference availability. Parent notified before this artifact.
Automatic refresh supports new byte-pinned editions under supported2026 target/law/current16 menu schemas, not arbitrary future scientific models or election years.

Review did not rehash/decode large arrays or establish forecast skill. Source authentication and operator/scientific admission remain separate; actual corrected16 qualification/import/public activation are pending.

changes: Only this new lab review artifact; no runtime/UI/index/client or other code edits.
